# wcag-a11y

Use this skill when auditing or remediating accessibility issues to WCAG 2.2 A and AA standards.

## Delegation

For WCAG 2.2 A/AA audit and remediation tasks, delegate to the `wcag-a11y-aa-specialist` agent:

- `.github/agents/wcag-a11y-aa-specialist.agent.md`

## References

- WCAG 2.2 specification: https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/
- WCAG MCP server (pre-configured in this repo's MCP setup; provides `wcag_get-criterion`, `wcag_search-wcag`, etc.)
- Browserstack accessibility devtools: https://www.browserstack.com/docs/accessibility-dev-tools/features/custom-component-linting
